Using `localeCompare` without an explicit locale can introduce environment-specific discrepancies across different runtimes (e.g., local vs CI). To ensure deterministic, locale-independent ordering, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison instead.

```suggestion
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(counts).sort(([left], [right]) => (left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0)));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid using Intl.Collator with an undefined locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.
</details>

+function resolvePath(root, relPath) {
+  return path.isAbsolute(relPath) ? relPath : path.join(root, relPath);
+}
+
+function readJson(root, relPath) {
+  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(resolvePath(root, relPath), 'utf8'));
+}
+
+function safeReadJson(root, relPath, artifactId, diagnostics) {
+  try {
+    return readJson(root, relPath);
+  } catch (error) {
+    diagnostics.push({
+      code: 'artifact_json_load_failed',
+      artifact_id: artifactId,
+      path: relPath,
+      reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+      severity: 'critical',
+    });
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function writeJson(root, relPath, value) {
+  const target = resolvePath(root, relPath);
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
+  fs.writeFileSync(target, `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`);
+}
+
+function writeText(root, relPath, value) {
+  const target = resolvePath(root, relPath);
+  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(target), { recursive: true });
+  fs.writeFileSync(target, value.endsWith('\n') ? value : `${value}\n`);
+}
+
+function sha256File(root, relPath) {
+  const target = resolvePath(root, relPath);
+  if (!fs.existsSync(target)) return null;
+  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(target)).digest('hex');
+}
+
+function valueAt(object, valuePath) {
+  if (!object || !valuePath) return null;
+  const parts = valuePath.split('.');
+  let current = object;
+  for (const part of parts) {
+    if (part === 'length') {
+      return Array.isArray(current) ? current.length : null;
+    }
+    current = current?.[part];
+    if (current === undefined || current === null) return null;
+  }
+  return current;
+}
+
+function normalizeIssue(value) {
+  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
+  if (typeof value === 'object') {
+    if (value.number) return `#${value.number}`;
+    return null;
+  }
+  const stringValue = String(value);
+  return stringValue.startsWith('#') ? stringValue : `#${stringValue}`;
+}
+
+function schemaVersionFor(jsonValue) {
+  if (!jsonValue) return null;
+  return jsonValue.schema_version ?? jsonValue.schemaVersion ?? jsonValue.$id ?? null;
+}
+
+function rowCountFor(definition, jsonValue) {
+  const explicit = valueAt(jsonValue, definition.rowCountPath);
+  if (Number.isFinite(explicit)) return explicit;
+  if (Array.isArray(explicit)) return explicit.length;
+  if (definition.rowCountPath) return null;
+  return null;
+}

+function artifactFromDefinition(root, paths, definition, diagnostics) {
+  const relPath = paths[definition.pathKey];
+  const exists = relPath ? fs.existsSync(resolvePath(root, relPath)) : false;
+  const shouldReadJson = exists && path.extname(relPath) === '.json';
+  const jsonValue = shouldReadJson ? safeReadJson(root, relPath, definition.artifact_id, diagnostics) : null;
+
+  if (definition.required_current && !exists) {
+    diagnostics.push({
+      code: 'required_artifact_missing',
+      artifact_id: definition.artifact_id,
+      path: relPath,
+      severity: 'critical',
+    });
+  }

+  return {
+    artifact_id: definition.artifact_id,
+    source_family: definition.source_family,
+    classification: definition.classification,
+    kg_role: definition.kg_role,
+    path: relPath,
+    exists,
+    schema_version: schemaVersionFor(jsonValue),
+    row_count: rowCountFor(definition, jsonValue),
+    row_count_source: definition.rowCountPath,
+    sha256: exists ? sha256File(root, relPath) : null,
+    producer_script: definition.producer_script ?? (jsonValue?.generated_by ? `scripts/method-map/${jsonValue.generated_by}` : null),
+    producing_issue: definition.producing_issue ?? normalizeIssue(jsonValue?.issue),
+    producing_pr: definition.producing_pr ?? null,
+    consumer_purpose: definition.consumer_purpose,
+    direct_kg_ingest_allowed: definition.classification === 'canonical_ingest_source',
+    required_current: definition.required_current === true,
+    superseded_by: definition.superseded_by ?? null,
+    chain: definition.chain ?? null,
+    blocks_graph_compile: definition.blocks_graph_compile === true,
+    missing_reason: definition.missing_reason ?? null,
+  };
+}
+
+function countArtifactsBy(artifacts, key) {
+  const counts = {};
+  for (const artifact of artifacts) {
+    const value = artifact[key] ?? 'none';
+    counts[value] = (counts[value] ?? 0) + 1;
+  }
+  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(counts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right)));
+}
+
+function getArtifact(artifacts, artifactId) {
+  return artifacts.find((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id === artifactId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function sourceScope(root, artifacts) {
+  const runtimeMap = getArtifact(artifacts, 'full_beta_runtime_source_map');
+  const visualInventory = getArtifact(artifacts, 'full_beta_visual_required_inventory');
+  const receipts = getArtifact(artifacts, 'source_visual_receipts_production_full_858');
+  const figureIndex = getArtifact(artifacts, 'source_figure_asset_production_index_full_858');
+  const runtimeGate = getArtifact(artifacts, 'figureasset_runtime_readiness_gate');
+  const plainText = getArtifact(artifacts, 'question_plain_text_v2');
+
+  const load = (artifact) => {
+    if (!artifact?.exists || path.extname(artifact.path) !== '.json') return null;
+    try {
+      return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(resolvePath(root, artifact.path), 'utf8'));
+    } catch {
+      return null;
+    }
+  };
+
+  const runtimeMapJson = load(runtimeMap);
+  const receiptsJson = load(receipts);
+  const figureIndexJson = load(figureIndex);
+  const runtimeGateJson = load(runtimeGate);
+  const plainTextJson = load(plainText);
+
+  return {
+    real_9709_question_rows: runtimeMap?.row_count ?? null,
+    normalized_plain_text_rows: plainText?.row_count ?? runtimeMapJson?.summary?.normalized_plain_text_rows ?? null,
+    text_only_ready_rows: runtimeMapJson?.summary?.text_only_ready_rows ?? plainTextJson?.summary?.text_only_ready_rows ?? null,
+    visual_required_rows: visualInventory?.row_count ?? runtimeMapJson?.summary?.image_context_required_rows ?? null,
+    source_visual_receipt_coverage_rows: receipts?.row_count ?? null,
+    accepted_source_visual_receipt_rows: receiptsJson?.summary?.accepted_receipt_count ?? null,
+    source_figure_asset_production_index_rows: figureIndex?.row_count ?? null,
+    visual_terminal_blocker_rows: figureIndexJson?.summary?.visual_blocked_invalid_rows
+      ?? figureIndexJson?.summary?.terminal_blocker_count
+      ?? figureIndexJson?.summary?.production_blocked_count
+      ?? countVisualTerminalBlockers(figureIndexJson),

+    external_vlm_call_count: load(getArtifact(artifacts, 'figureasset_production_readiness_closeout'))?.summary?.external_vlm_call_count ?? null,
+  };
+}
+
+function countVisualTerminalBlockers(figureIndexJson) {
+  if (!figureIndexJson || !Array.isArray(figureIndexJson.rows)) return null;
+  return figureIndexJson.rows.filter((row) => row.student_display_eligible_final !== true

+function check(id, condition, extra = {}) {

+    id,
+    status: condition ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    ...extra,
+  };
+}

+function validateManifest(manifest) {
+  const artifacts = manifest.artifacts;
+  const canonicalArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'canonical_ingest_source');
+  const staleArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'stale_do_not_consume_directly');
+  const blockedArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'blocked_missing');
+  const currentRequiredArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.required_current);
+
+  const missingFamilies = REQUIRED_SOURCE_FAMILIES.filter((family) => !artifacts.some((artifact) => artifact.source_family === family));
+  const invalidClassifications = artifacts.filter((artifact) => !CLASSIFICATIONS.has(artifact.classification));
+  const missingRequiredArtifacts = currentRequiredArtifacts.filter((artifact) => !artifact.exists);
+  const missingMetadataArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification !== 'blocked_missing').filter((artifact) => (
+    !artifact.path
+    || artifact.exists !== true
+    || !artifact.consumer_purpose
+    || artifact.sha256 === null
+    || artifact.producer_script === null
+  ));
+  const staleCanonicalArtifacts = staleArtifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.direct_kg_ingest_allowed);
+  const unscopedBlockedArtifacts = blockedArtifacts.filter((artifact) => !artifact.missing_reason || !artifact.consumer_purpose);
+  const graphCompileBlockingGaps = blockedArtifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.blocks_graph_compile);
+  const faCropSchemaMisuse = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.chain === 'FA-CROP-HVY'
+    && artifact.kg_role === 'kg_schema_definition');
+
+  const countMismatches = Object.entries(EXPECTED_COUNTS).filter(([key, expected]) => manifest.source_scope[key] !== expected);
+  const checks = [
+    check('required_source_families_accounted_for', missingFamilies.length === 0, { missing_families: missingFamilies }),
+    check('allowed_classifications_only', invalidClassifications.length === 0, {
+      invalid_artifact_ids: invalidClassifications.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('required_current_artifacts_present', missingRequiredArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      missing_artifact_ids: missingRequiredArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('artifact_metadata_complete', missingMetadataArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      incomplete_artifact_ids: missingMetadataArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('full_3530_plus_858_scope_preserved', countMismatches.length === 0, {
+      expected_counts: EXPECTED_COUNTS,
+      observed_counts: manifest.source_scope,
+      mismatches: countMismatches.map(([key, expected]) => ({ key, expected, observed: manifest.source_scope[key] })),
+    }),
+    check('stale_inputs_not_canonical', staleCanonicalArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      stale_canonical_artifact_ids: staleCanonicalArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('blocked_missing_inputs_are_explicit', blockedArtifacts.length > 0 && unscopedBlockedArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      blocked_missing_count: blockedArtifacts.length,
+      graph_compile_blocking_gap_count: graphCompileBlockingGaps.length,
+      unscoped_blocked_artifact_ids: unscopedBlockedArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('fa_crop_hvy_artifacts_are_evidence_not_kg_schema', faCropSchemaMisuse.length === 0, {
+      violating_artifact_ids: faCropSchemaMisuse.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+  ];

+  const parts = valuePath.split('.');
+  let current = object;
+  for (const part of parts) {
+    if (part === 'length') {
+      return Array.isArray(current) ? current.length : null;
+    }
+    current = current?.[part];
+    if (current === undefined || current === null) return null;
+  }
+  return current;
+}
+
+function normalizeIssue(value) {
+  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
+  if (typeof value === 'object') {
+    if (value.number) return `#${value.number}`;
+    return null;
+  }
+  const stringValue = String(value);
+  return stringValue.startsWith('#') ? stringValue : `#${stringValue}`;
+}
+
+function schemaVersionFor(jsonValue) {
+  if (!jsonValue) return null;
+  return jsonValue.schema_version ?? jsonValue.schemaVersion ?? jsonValue.$id ?? null;
+}
+
+function rowCountFor(definition, jsonValue) {
+  const explicit = valueAt(jsonValue, definition.rowCountPath);
+  if (Number.isFinite(explicit)) return explicit;
+  if (Array.isArray(explicit)) return explicit.length;
+  if (definition.rowCountPath) return null;
+  return null;
+}
+
+function artifactFromDefinition(root, paths, definition, diagnostics) {
+  const relPath = paths[definition.pathKey];
+  const exists = relPath ? fs.existsSync(resolvePath(root, relPath)) : false;
+  const shouldReadJson = exists && path.extname(relPath) === '.json';
+  const jsonValue = shouldReadJson ? safeReadJson(root, relPath, definition.artifact_id, diagnostics) : null;
+
+  if (definition.required_current && !exists) {
+    diagnostics.push({
+      code: 'required_artifact_missing',
+      artifact_id: definition.artifact_id,
+      path: relPath,
+      severity: 'critical',
+    });
+  }
+
+  return {
+    artifact_id: definition.artifact_id,
+    source_family: definition.source_family,
+    classification: definition.classification,
+    kg_role: definition.kg_role,
+    path: relPath,
+    exists,
+    schema_version: schemaVersionFor(jsonValue),
+    row_count: rowCountFor(definition, jsonValue),
+    row_count_source: definition.rowCountPath,
+    sha256: exists ? sha256File(root, relPath) : null,
+    producer_script: definition.producer_script ?? (jsonValue?.generated_by ? `scripts/method-map/${jsonValue.generated_by}` : null),
+    producing_issue: definition.producing_issue ?? normalizeIssue(jsonValue?.issue),
+    producing_pr: definition.producing_pr ?? null,
+    consumer_purpose: definition.consumer_purpose,
+    direct_kg_ingest_allowed: definition.classification === 'canonical_ingest_source',
+    required_current: definition.required_current === true,
+    superseded_by: definition.superseded_by ?? null,
+    chain: definition.chain ?? null,
+    blocks_graph_compile: definition.blocks_graph_compile === true,
+    missing_reason: definition.missing_reason ?? null,
+  };
+}
+
+function countArtifactsBy(artifacts, key) {
+  const counts = {};
+  for (const artifact of artifacts) {
+    const value = artifact[key] ?? 'none';
+    counts[value] = (counts[value] ?? 0) + 1;
+  }
+  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(counts).sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right)));
+}
+
+function getArtifact(artifacts, artifactId) {
+  return artifacts.find((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id === artifactId) ?? null;
+}
+
+function sourceScope(root, artifacts) {
+  const runtimeMap = getArtifact(artifacts, 'full_beta_runtime_source_map');
+  const visualInventory = getArtifact(artifacts, 'full_beta_visual_required_inventory');
+  const receipts = getArtifact(artifacts, 'source_visual_receipts_production_full_858');
+  const figureIndex = getArtifact(artifacts, 'source_figure_asset_production_index_full_858');
+  const runtimeGate = getArtifact(artifacts, 'figureasset_runtime_readiness_gate');
+  const plainText = getArtifact(artifacts, 'question_plain_text_v2');
+
+  const load = (artifact) => {
+    if (!artifact?.exists || path.extname(artifact.path) !== '.json') return null;
+    try {
+      return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(resolvePath(root, artifact.path), 'utf8'));
+    } catch {
+      return null;
+    }
+  };
+
+  const runtimeMapJson = load(runtimeMap);
+  const receiptsJson = load(receipts);
+  const figureIndexJson = load(figureIndex);
+  const runtimeGateJson = load(runtimeGate);
+  const plainTextJson = load(plainText);
+
+  return {
+    real_9709_question_rows: runtimeMap?.row_count ?? null,
+    normalized_plain_text_rows: plainText?.row_count ?? runtimeMapJson?.summary?.normalized_plain_text_rows ?? null,
+    text_only_ready_rows: runtimeMapJson?.summary?.text_only_ready_rows ?? plainTextJson?.summary?.text_only_ready_rows ?? null,
+    visual_required_rows: visualInventory?.row_count ?? runtimeMapJson?.summary?.image_context_required_rows ?? null,
+    source_visual_receipt_coverage_rows: receipts?.row_count ?? null,
+    accepted_source_visual_receipt_rows: receiptsJson?.summary?.accepted_receipt_count ?? null,
+    source_figure_asset_production_index_rows: figureIndex?.row_count ?? null,
+    visual_terminal_blocker_rows: figureIndexJson?.summary?.visual_blocked_invalid_rows

+      ?? figureIndexJson?.summary?.production_blocked_count
+      ?? countVisualTerminalBlockers(figureIndexJson),
+    student_display_eligible_visual_rows: runtimeGateJson?.summary?.visual_student_display_eligible_final_rows ?? null,
+    external_vlm_call_count: load(getArtifact(artifacts, 'figureasset_production_readiness_closeout'))?.summary?.external_vlm_call_count ?? null,
+  };
+}
+
+function countVisualTerminalBlockers(figureIndexJson) {
+  if (!figureIndexJson || !Array.isArray(figureIndexJson.rows)) return null;
+  return figureIndexJson.rows.filter((row) => row.student_display_eligible_final !== true
+    && String(row.asset_production_posture ?? '').startsWith('production_blocked_')).length;
+}
+
+function check(id, condition, extra = {}) {
+  return {
+    id,
+    status: condition ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+    ...extra,
+  };
+}
+
+function validateManifest(manifest) {
+  const artifacts = manifest.artifacts;
+  const canonicalArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'canonical_ingest_source');
+  const staleArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'stale_do_not_consume_directly');
+  const blockedArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'blocked_missing');
+  const currentRequiredArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.required_current);
+
+  const missingFamilies = REQUIRED_SOURCE_FAMILIES.filter((family) => !artifacts.some((artifact) => artifact.source_family === family));
+  const invalidClassifications = artifacts.filter((artifact) => !CLASSIFICATIONS.has(artifact.classification));
+  const missingRequiredArtifacts = currentRequiredArtifacts.filter((artifact) => !artifact.exists);
+  const missingMetadataArtifacts = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification !== 'blocked_missing').filter((artifact) => (
+    !artifact.path
+    || artifact.exists !== true
+    || !artifact.consumer_purpose
+    || artifact.sha256 === null
+    || artifact.producer_script === null
+  ));
+  const staleCanonicalArtifacts = staleArtifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.direct_kg_ingest_allowed);
+  const unscopedBlockedArtifacts = blockedArtifacts.filter((artifact) => !artifact.missing_reason || !artifact.consumer_purpose);
+  const graphCompileBlockingGaps = blockedArtifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.blocks_graph_compile);
+  const faCropSchemaMisuse = artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.chain === 'FA-CROP-HVY'
+    && artifact.kg_role === 'kg_schema_definition');
+
+  const countMismatches = Object.entries(EXPECTED_COUNTS).filter(([key, expected]) => manifest.source_scope[key] !== expected);
+  const checks = [
+    check('required_source_families_accounted_for', missingFamilies.length === 0, { missing_families: missingFamilies }),
+    check('allowed_classifications_only', invalidClassifications.length === 0, {
+      invalid_artifact_ids: invalidClassifications.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('required_current_artifacts_present', missingRequiredArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      missing_artifact_ids: missingRequiredArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('artifact_metadata_complete', missingMetadataArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      incomplete_artifact_ids: missingMetadataArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('full_3530_plus_858_scope_preserved', countMismatches.length === 0, {
+      expected_counts: EXPECTED_COUNTS,
+      observed_counts: manifest.source_scope,
+      mismatches: countMismatches.map(([key, expected]) => ({ key, expected, observed: manifest.source_scope[key] })),
+    }),
+    check('stale_inputs_not_canonical', staleCanonicalArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      stale_canonical_artifact_ids: staleCanonicalArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('blocked_missing_inputs_are_explicit', blockedArtifacts.length > 0 && unscopedBlockedArtifacts.length === 0, {
+      blocked_missing_count: blockedArtifacts.length,
+      graph_compile_blocking_gap_count: graphCompileBlockingGaps.length,
+      unscoped_blocked_artifact_ids: unscopedBlockedArtifacts.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+    check('fa_crop_hvy_artifacts_are_evidence_not_kg_schema', faCropSchemaMisuse.length === 0, {
+      violating_artifact_ids: faCropSchemaMisuse.map((artifact) => artifact.artifact_id),
+    }),
+  ];
+
+  const failedChecks = checks.filter((item) => item.status !== 'pass');
+  return {
+    schema_version: 'kg_source_artifact_ingestion_manifest_validator_result.v1',
+    generated_at: manifest.generated_at,
+    generated_by: SCRIPT_NAME,
+    manifest_path: DEFAULT_PATHS.manifestOut,
+    summary: {
+      validation_status: failedChecks.length === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail',
+      check_count: checks.length,
+      failed_check_count: failedChecks.length,
+      artifact_count: artifacts.length,
+      canonical_ingest_source_count: canonicalArtifacts.length,
+      derived_readback_count: artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'derived_readback').length,
+      auxiliary_evidence_count: artifacts.filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'auxiliary_evidence').length,
+      stale_do_not_consume_directly_count: staleArtifacts.length,
+      blocked_missing_count: blockedArtifacts.length,
+      required_current_artifact_count: currentRequiredArtifacts.length,
+      required_current_missing_count: missingRequiredArtifacts.length,
+      required_source_family_count: REQUIRED_SOURCE_FAMILIES.length,
+    },
+    checks,
+  };
+}
+
+function buildReadback(manifest, validatorResult) {
+  const lines = [
+    '# KG Source Artifact Ingestion Manifest Readback',
+    '',
+    `Generated: ${manifest.generated_at.slice(0, 10)}`,
+    '',
+    'Issue: #1280',
+    'Parent: #1278',
+    `Validator status: ${validatorResult.summary.validation_status}`,
+    '',
+    '## Scope Counts',
+    '',
+    '| Metric | Count |',
+    '| --- | ---: |',
+    `| Real 9709 question rows | ${manifest.source_scope.real_9709_question_rows} |`,
+    `| Normalized plain-text rows | ${manifest.source_scope.normalized_plain_text_rows} |`,
+    `| Text-only ready rows | ${manifest.source_scope.text_only_ready_rows} |`,
+    `| Visual-required rows | ${manifest.source_scope.visual_required_rows} |`,
+    `| SourceVisualReceipt coverage rows | ${manifest.source_scope.source_visual_receipt_coverage_rows} |`,
+    `| Accepted SourceVisualReceipt rows | ${manifest.source_scope.accepted_source_visual_receipt_rows} |`,
+    `| SourceFigureAsset production index rows | ${manifest.source_scope.source_figure_asset_production_index_rows} |`,
+    `| Visual terminal blocker rows | ${manifest.source_scope.visual_terminal_blocker_rows} |`,
+    `| Student-display eligible visual rows | ${manifest.source_scope.student_display_eligible_visual_rows} |`,
+    `| External VLM calls in closeout | ${manifest.source_scope.external_vlm_call_count} |`,
+    '',
+    '## Classification Counts',
+    '',
+    '| Classification | Count |',
+    '| --- | ---: |',
+    ...Object.entries(manifest.summary.classification_counts).map(([classification, count]) => `| ${classification} | ${count} |`),
+    '',
+    '## Canonical Ingest Sources',
+    '',
+    '| Artifact | Family | Rows | Producer | Consumer purpose |',
+    '| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |',
+    ...manifest.artifacts
+      .filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'canonical_ingest_source')
+      .map((artifact) => `| \`${artifact.path}\` | ${artifact.source_family} | ${artifact.row_count ?? ''} | ${artifact.producer_script ?? ''} | ${artifact.consumer_purpose} |`),
+    '',
+    '## Stale Or Blocked Inputs',
+    '',
+    '| Artifact | Classification | Reason |',
+    '| --- | --- | --- |',
+    ...manifest.artifacts
+      .filter((artifact) => artifact.classification === 'stale_do_not_consume_directly' || artifact.classification === 'blocked_missing')
+      .map((artifact) => `| \`${artifact.path}\` | ${artifact.classification} | ${artifact.missing_reason ?? artifact.consumer_purpose} |`),
+    '',
+    '## Validator Checks',
+    '',
+    '| Check | Status |',
+    '| --- | --- |',
+    ...validatorResult.checks.map((item) => `| ${item.id} | ${item.status} |`),
+    '',
+  ];
+  return lines.join('\n');
+}
+
+export function buildKgSourceArtifactIngestionManifest(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options);
+  const generatedAt = options.generatedAt ?? DEFAULT_GENERATED_AT;
+  const paths = { ...DEFAULT_PATHS, ...(options.paths ?? {}) };
+  const diagnostics = [];
+  const artifacts = ARTIFACT_DEFINITIONS.map((definition) => artifactFromDefinition(root, paths, definition, diagnostics));
